# U.S. Religion Census

> > Comprehensive decadal survey of county-level religious congregations, adherents, and demographics across the United States, conducted by the Association of Statisticians of American Religious Bodies (ASARB).

The U.S. Religion Census provides detailed statistical data on religious congregations and adherents at the county level, published every ten years in partnership with The Association of Religion Data Archives (ARDA) and supported by organizations including Lilly Endowment, Inc., National Council of Churches, and Glenmary Research Center.

## Key Topics

- Association of Statisticians of American Religious Bodies (ASARB)

- U.S. religious landscape
